parsed.explanation: No visitor-facing exposure is documented: same-sex conduct is legal, no presentation or morality offence is cited, there is no facility or birth-sex rule, no police targeting, no violence figures, and a 2023 report records no torture or arbitrary detention. Hate-crime/hate-speech laws are enforced (a 2010 conviction), but name sexual orientation only — a climate signal, not a trans protection. Negatives are mostly resident-facing (no legal gender recognition, failed anti-discrimination bills) which weigh lightly under the rules, plus a genuinely conservative social climate: ~10 people out, no Pride, Catholic moral disapproval — social friction to mild hostility, tier 3, with no state threat-framing. Open questions (custody placement, document scrutiny) are unanswered, not exposures. No documented acceptance tradition either, so this sits below the acceptance-with-protections tier: Reduced Risk, lower half.
